about: Why parts of a run failed, read by code from the run's own log (diagnosis.py) and shown with the report. Each cause names its kind (llm: a limit of the local model; source: a site or database refused or was unreadable; search: a search provider failed; design: a rule of Titan's own; input: something the question did not give), what Titan already does about it (handled_by) and what could be done next (workaround).

causes.match: quote not found verbatim|quote shorter than
causes.label: The model quoted words the page does not contain, or too few of them
causes.handled_by: the claim is refused (every claim needs a word-for-word quote); quotes are narrowed or widened by code where they nearly match
causes.workaround: a larger extraction model, or extraction by sentence selection (the model picks sentence numbers; code copies the text)

causes.match: not a statement of a fact|does not address any needed fact
causes.label: The model returned remarks about the page, or claims that answer nothing asked
causes.handled_by: refused by code
causes.workaround: fewer, tighter extraction fields; the company-events ontology as a fixed list of claim kinds

causes.label: The model's output did not fit the required shape
causes.handled_by: the malformed items are dropped and counted
causes.workaround: a smaller schema per call, or a model with stronger structured output

causes.label: A model call failed or returned nothing usable
causes.handled_by: retried once, then that step is skipped
causes.workaround: check that Ollama is running and the model fits in memory; a smaller context for the call

causes.label: The model invented an identifier (a CIK, a paper id) the question never gave
causes.handled_by: the call is refused; EDGAR is now read by the EDGAR skill, which looks the CIK up in the SEC's own list
causes.workaround: a lookup skill for each connector that needs ids (OpenAlex ids by title search)

causes.label: The planner wrote a guessed figure into a search query
causes.handled_by: the figure is removed before searching
causes.workaround: queries built from templates for known question shapes

causes.label: The planner listed a premise that names nothing specific
causes.handled_by: dropped by code before the premise check
causes.workaround: none needed beyond the code filter

causes.label: The writer added sentences no claim backs
causes.handled_by: removed from the answer and listed with the report
causes.workaround: writing event by event from a fixed template, with the model only phrasing each cited claim

causes.label: The first draft broke writing rules and was rewritten
causes.handled_by: scored by the matrix; a worse rewrite never replaces a better draft
causes.workaround: the golden set, to tune the rules the model breaks most

causes.label: A site refused Titan's request (blocked or rate-limited)
causes.handled_by: the page is skipped; other copies of the same document (a wire service, EDGAR) can still be read
causes.workaround: read the company's filings on EDGAR and its releases on wire services, which serve automated readers; never evade a block

causes.label: A page no longer exists
causes.handled_by: skipped
causes.workaround: the Internet Archive's copy, if the archive is added as a source

causes.label: A page could not be read (no text, scanned, or the connection failed)
causes.handled_by: pages with no text are rendered in a browser once; otherwise skipped
causes.workaround: OCR for scanned PDFs

causes.label: A data-source call failed
causes.handled_by: logged; the web search carries on
causes.workaround: fix the call parameters in the connector's profile

causes.label: Part of the EDGAR reading failed
causes.handled_by: logged; other filings and the web carry on
causes.workaround: retry later (sec.gov rate limits apply)

causes.label: A search provider failed, or a search found nothing at all
causes.handled_by: results from the other providers are used; SearXNG is started again once if it does not answer
causes.workaround: check WSL and Docker (SearXNG runs there); the Brave API key and its quota

causes.label: An engine inside SearXNG timed out, was blocked (CAPTCHA) or rate-limited, while the search still had results
causes.handled_by: the engine is rested for 10 to 30 minutes and left out of SearXNG queries; the Brave API and the other engines carried the search
causes.workaround: none needed unless it repeats; SearXNG no longer scrapes Brave (the Brave API is used directly)

causes.label: Reading stopped once the needed facts had claims from enough sources
causes.handled_by: the unread pages are kept and read if a gap remains
causes.workaround: list questions never stop early (they collect every event)

causes.label: Claims were left unchecked because the fact was already backed
causes.handled_by: they stay on record, marked unchecked
causes.workaround: a larger check budget when speed matters less

causes.label: A search or reading budget ran out
causes.handled_by: the run reports what it found
causes.workaround: raise the budget for this kind of question

causes.label: The subject is not an SEC registrant under that name
causes.handled_by: EDGAR is not read; the web carries on
causes.workaround: give the ticker or the CIK in the question, or the SEC's registrant name (e.g. Alphabet for Google)

causes.label: Figures in a financial statement could not be confirmed (scanned page: the two OCR engines disagreed, only one read it, or one was unsure; or the figure is in a sum that does not add up, or its column's period could not be read)
causes.handled_by: the figure is kept, never dropped: taken as its likeliest reading (one with which its sums add up, else one that fits its column, e.g. '7.316.94' in a two-decimal column as 7,316.94), with what was printed, both readings, its place on the page and why; marked doubt with 'please double-check', and left out of the figures answers are checked against unless asked for
causes.workaround: a person checks the figure on the page; a cleaner copy of the document (the company's own PDF with a text layer, or its XBRL filing) replaces OCR entirely

causes.label: Scanned pages that were not read
causes.handled_by: the pages are listed with the reason (OCR not installed, over the page limit, or unreadable)
causes.workaround: install Tesseract (winget install UB-Mannheim.TesseractOCR) or raise max_ocr_pages in definitions/skills/statements.json
